$comment: The macOS 27 dark standard material at the Glass
appearance slider's 0.25 position (`NSGlassTintAmount` 0.25, the clearer glass), as a PATCH over the unmoved runtime
default — W43 Decision Log 6; it is not a difference over the 0.5 document.
W48 G1, claims §5.213: the span-graded dark transmission and the receded fine term over
d0219cd684bf (two operators, the tone ordinates held), fitted in two stages in scratch under the hashed part 2 on the dark
WebGPU fit cells at both scales, T1 read against Apple's texture. The light 0.25 pair, the 0.5
generations and the 26.5 rows did not move (X60). It supersedes the document named in
`supersedes`; `entries` keeps the snapshot's record for every leaf W48 left where it was and
records each leaf W48 moved with its previous and 0.5 values. By X64 and X67 it may name

sizeScatterFloor2x, sizeScatterRampStartThin1x, sizeScatterRampStartThick1x, sizeScatterRampStartFar1x, sizeScatterRampStartThin2x, sizeScatterRampStartThick2x, sizeScatterRampStartFar2x, sizeHeavySecondShareFar2x, sizeOcclusionGain, sizeScatterSpanMax, sizeScatterSpanMax2x, tintAlphaFar1x and tintAlphaFar2x beside its 0.5 twin's leaves (X44 narrowed).

measurement.gate: W48 G1, claims §5.213; charter docs/doperpowers/specs/2026-10-06-w48-dark-operators-fit.md clauses 6-8; Decision Logs 1-7
measurement.fixtures: apps/reference-apple/fixtures/apple-macos-27.0-{1x,2x}-dark-standard-glass0.25, the W43 G1a bed at seven runs per cell, slider 0.25 (§5.199); T1's bar from those runs (§5.202 §2)
measurement.fixtureSets: the dark fit cells (the T1 gate cells less the canonical holdout and W46's referee manifest w46-referees-1, with L1's calibration and validation population) fitted; no holdout or referee read to fit
measurement.webCell: renderer webgpu, samplingBackend gpu-texture, adapter apple/metal-3, candidate mode (W43 G0 (f))
measurement.objective: part 2's stage objectives (T1's selection metric over each stage's cells, both scales) under its search procedure, tie rule and selection rule, from d0219cd684bf (results/2026-10-06-w48-g1-refit/fit/path/)

method: Light: solved with the thin row (above). Dark: least squares on the dark calibration thick
cells, its knot-2 step bounded by L1's growth clause on the dark checkerboard rrect-md cells
(Decision Log 7 item 3: only the thick row moves in dark).
